listIndentOnly: Increasing indentation in %@ is only supported for list items, not other content. Switch to %@ to adjust indentation.
languageRestartMessage: DawnMark's menus and interface have been updated. Some macOS menus and system panels will use the selected language after you quit and reopen DawnMark. This change does not affect other apps.
heading: Heading %d
folderPermission: Select the folder containing this Markdown file to allow DawnMark to save its images.
operationFailed: The operation could not be completed. Check file permissions and try again.
invalidName: Enter a valid document name without slashes or colons.
alreadyExists: A document folder with this name already exists.
invalidImage: This file is not a supported image.
unsafePath: The resource is outside the document folder.
trialDisclosure: Try all features for 15 consecutive days after claiming the free trial. After the trial, documents remain readable but editing and document creation require a one-time purchase. The trial does not automatically charge or renew.
purchaseFailed: The purchase could not be completed. Check your App Store connection and try again.
restoreEmpty: Restored purchases checked. No active full access was found.
helpContent: DawnMark stores each document in its own folder. Images are saved in an images subfolder and referenced with relative paths. Copy the whole document folder to keep text and images together. Use File to create or open documents, Format and Insert to edit content, and View to switch between Markdown Source and Visual Editing. Unsupported Markdown can be edited in source mode.
unsupportedEdit: This operation is not available at the current selection. You can edit the Markdown source instead.
unsavedChanges: Save changes before closing this document?
resourceWarning: Some image references are outside the document folder or unavailable. Copy the images into the document folder and update their references before making an independent copy. Remote images must be downloaded explicitly.
collected: Local images collected into the document folder.
imageTooLarge: The image exceeds the 50 MiB or 100-million-pixel limit.
imageImportCancelled: Image insertion was cancelled because its target text changed. Select a new position and insert again.
